title: Progressions: practice set 1
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 6 questions, 12 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: What is the 7th term of the arithmetic progression 5, 9, 13, ...?
What is the sum of all two-digit multiples of 7?
In the progression 3, 6, 12, ..., which term is 384?
What is the sum to infinity of 12 + 6 + 3 + 1.5 + ...?
Rohit saves ₹500 in the first month and each month saves ₹100 more than the month before. How much does he save in 12 months?
